scope: Exact local generation verifier package only; not owner approval, private-pack review, baseline seal or A9 closure.

findings: Inference fields could inject raw output and override trusted report-envelope/provenance fields.
Grounded predicate accepted arbitrary unsupported suffixes.
Malformed config escaped the bounded error and architectures accepted a string.
Snapshot, inference and wall-clock resource bounds plus direct dependency pins were incomplete.
Numeric observations lacked upper bounds and exact output-hash/runtime-version bindings.
A caller-supplied worker flag bypassed the timeout parent.
The CLI allowed the nominal 600-second timeout to be raised to 3,600 seconds.

limitations: The smoke is controlled prompt adherence, not broad grounding quality.
The pipe capability is a trusted-local accidental/direct CLI guard, not same-user origin authentication.
Library offline mode is not OS-level network isolation.
Cached identity is not cryptographic publisher or license provenance.
No human approval, owner-reviewed private pack, real benchmark or baseline seal is represented.
